# Overview

This analysis addresses whether H3K27me3-bound genes that dynamically change
during cerebellar granule neuron differentiation are associated with prognosis
in SHH medulloblastoma. We use the Cavalli et al. (2017) cohort of 763
medulloblastoma patients, restricting to the SHH subgroup (n=172 with overall
survival data).

The differentiation genes (n=786) were defined as genes dynamically expressed
in the granule neuron lineage with >2 log2 fold-change and mid-to-late
activation timing (t50). H3K27me3 binding status was determined by Gaussian
mixture model binarization of P7 GNP ChIP-seq data.

```{r libraries}
suppressMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(survival)
  library(survminer)
  library(readxl)
  library(limma)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(cowplot)
})

setwd("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/Ezh2_2022/")
```

# 1. Data Loading

```{r load-data}
# Master table with gene annotations, ChIP-seq, and classification
master <- read.table("gnp_MB_histone_k_toc_t50.txt",
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, quote = "\"")
colnames(master) <- gsub("\"", "", colnames(master))

# Mouse-human ortholog mapping
orth <- read.table("orth_mouse_filt_best.txt",
  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "\"")

# Cavalli et al. expression matrix (763 MB tumors, microarray)
expr_raw <- read.table("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/GSE85217_M_exp_763_MB_SubtypeStudy_TaylorLab.txt",
  sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, quote = "")

# Clinical/survival data
clinical <- read_excel("~/Dropbox/GNP_MB_integrate/2016_06_18_integration/cavali_Clinical_data.xlsx",
  sheet = 1, skip = 1)
```

# 2. Define Gene Sets

We define differentiation genes from the master table and classify them by
H3K27me3 binding and EZH2 anticorrelation status.

## 2.1 Differentiation Genes

```{r diff-genes}
# 786 differentiation genes: dynamically expressed, >2 log2FC, mid/late timing
diff_genes_master <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(max_cat == "P14_P56",
    group_1 == "Dynically expressed in granule neuron lineage",
    group_2 == ">2 log2FC",
    t50_cat %in% c("Mid", "Late"),
    !grepl("_exclude", max_cat_exclude))

cat("Differentiation genes in master table:", nrow(diff_genes_master), "\n")

# Map to human orthologs
diff_orth <- merge(diff_genes_master, orth,
  by.x = "ensembl_gene_id", by.y = "mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene")
diff_orth <- diff_orth[!duplicated(diff_orth$hg_ensembl_gene_id.y), ]

cat("With human orthologs:", nrow(diff_orth), "\n")
cat("H3K27me3-bound:", sum(diff_orth$H3K27me3_bin == 1), "\n")
cat("H3K27me3-unbound:", sum(diff_orth$H3K27me3_bin == 0), "\n")
```

## 2.2 EZH2 Anticorrelation in Human SHH-MB

To identify differentiation genes whose expression anticorrelates with EZH2
in human SHH tumors, we split SHH patients by EZH2 expression (bottom 30% vs
top 30%) and ran limma differential expression. Genes significantly upregulated
when EZH2 is low (logFC > 0, adj.P < 0.05) are classified as EZH2-anticorrelated.

```{r ezh2-anticorrelation}
sample_cols <- grep("^MB_SubtypeStudy_", colnames(expr_raw), value = TRUE)
SHH_all <- intersect(clinical$Study_ID[clinical$Subgroup == "SHH"], sample_cols)

# EZH2 expression percentile split
ezh2_row <- expr_raw %>% dplyr::filter(HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77 == "EZH2")
ezh2_vals <- sort(setNames(as.numeric(ezh2_row[1, SHH_all]), SHH_all))
n_shh <- length(ezh2_vals)
pctiles <- round(100 * (1:n_shh) / n_shh, 1)
ezh2_df <- data.frame(ptn = names(ezh2_vals), pctile = pctiles, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ezh2_df$grp <- case_when(ezh2_df$pctile <= 30 ~ "low", ezh2_df$pctile >= 70 ~ "high", TRUE ~ "mid")

# Limma: EZH2-low vs EZH2-high
ez_tb <- ezh2_df %>% dplyr::filter(grp != "mid")
human_MB_SHH <- expr_raw %>% dplyr::select(Probe.Set.Name, one_of(ez_tb$ptn))
rownames(human_MB_SHH) <- human_MB_SHH$Probe.Set.Name; human_MB_SHH$Probe.Set.Name <- NULL
ez_meta <- plyr::mapvalues(colnames(human_MB_SHH), from = ez_tb$ptn, to = ez_tb$grp)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + factor(ez_meta, levels = c("high", "low")))
colnames(design) <- c("high", "low")
fit <- lmFit(human_MB_SHH, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, makeContrasts(low - high, levels = design)))
de_res <- topTable(fit2, sort = "none", n = Inf)
de_res$Probe.Set.Name <- rownames(de_res)
probe_ann <- expr_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(Probe.Set.Name, EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77, HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77)
de_res <- merge(probe_ann, de_res, by = "Probe.Set.Name")

# Merge with diff genes
diff_de <- merge(diff_orth, de_res, by.x = "hg_ensembl_gene_id.y", by.y = "EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77")
diff_de <- diff_de[!duplicated(diff_de$hg_ensembl_gene_id.y), ]
diff_de$ezh2_anticorr <- diff_de$logFC > 0 & diff_de$adj.P.Val < 0.05

# 4-way classification
diff_de$gene_set <- factor(case_when(
  diff_de$H3K27me3_bin == 1 & diff_de$ezh2_anticorr ~ "H3K27me3+ & EZH2-anticorr",
  diff_de$H3K27me3_bin == 1 & !diff_de$ezh2_anticorr ~ "H3K27me3+ only",
  diff_de$H3K27me3_bin == 0 & diff_de$ezh2_anticorr ~ "EZH2-anticorr only",
  TRUE ~ "Other diff gene"
), levels = c("H3K27me3+ & EZH2-anticorr", "H3K27me3+ only",
              "EZH2-anticorr only", "Other diff gene"))

cat("\nGene set classification:\n")
print(table(diff_de$gene_set))
cat("\nEZH2-anticorrelated:", sum(diff_de$ezh2_anticorr), "/", nrow(diff_de), "\n")
```

# 3. Survival Cohort

```{r survival-cohort}
shh_clinical <- clinical %>%
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "SHH") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(os_time = as.numeric(`OS (years)`), os_event = as.numeric(Dead)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(os_time) & !is.na(os_event) & os_time > 0) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Study_ID %in% sample_cols)

shh_ids <- shh_clinical$Study_ID

cat("SHH patients with survival data:", nrow(shh_clinical), "\n")
cat("Events (deaths):", sum(shh_clinical$os_event), "\n")
cat("Median follow-up:", round(median(shh_clinical$os_time), 1), "years\n")
```

# 4. Per-Gene Survival Analysis

For each differentiation gene with a human ortholog present in the expression
dataset, we split SHH patients at the median expression level and fit a Cox
proportional hazards model (High vs Low expression).

```{r per-gene-cox}
expr_diff <- expr_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77 %in% diff_orth$hg_ensembl_gene_id.y) %>%
  dplyr::select(EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77, HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77, all_of(shh_ids))
expr_diff <- expr_diff[!duplicated(expr_diff$EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77), ]

cox_list <- lapply(1:nrow(expr_diff), function(i) {
  ens_id <- expr_diff$EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77[i]
  hgnc <- expr_diff$HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77[i]
  ge <- as.numeric(expr_diff[i, shh_ids])
  names(ge) <- shh_ids
  med <- median(ge, na.rm = TRUE)
  sdf <- data.frame(Study_ID = shh_ids,
    expr_group = factor(ifelse(ge > med, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shh_clinical[, c("Study_ID", "os_time", "os_event")], by = "Study_ID")
  cx <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ expr_group, data = sdf), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(cx)) return(NULL)
  cs <- summary(cx)
  data.frame(hg_ensembl = ens_id, hgnc_symbol = hgnc,
    cox_pval = cs$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    cox_hr = cs$coefficients[1, "exp(coef)"],
    coef = cs$coefficients[1, "coef"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
cox_df <- do.call(rbind, cox_list)

# Merge with gene info
surv <- merge(diff_orth[, c("hg_ensembl_gene_id.y", "ensembl_gene_id", "mgi_symbol",
  "H3K27me3_bin", "H3K27me3", "t50_cat")],
  cox_df, by.x = "hg_ensembl_gene_id.y", by.y = "hg_ensembl") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cox_pval) & is.finite(log2(cox_hr))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log2_hr = log2(cox_hr),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(cox_pval),
    direction = ifelse(cox_hr < 1, "Protective", "Risk"),
    sig = cox_pval < 0.05,
    gene_group = ifelse(H3K27me3_bin == 1, "H3K27me3-bound diff gene",
                        "Diff gene (H3K27me3-unbound)")
  )
```

## Summary

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Category = c("All differentiation genes", "H3K27me3-bound", "H3K27me3-unbound"),
  Tested = c(nrow(surv), sum(surv$H3K27me3_bin == 1), sum(surv$H3K27me3_bin == 0)),
  Significant = c(sum(surv$sig),
    sum(surv$sig & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 1),
    sum(surv$sig & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 0)),
  Protective = c(sum(surv$sig & surv$direction == "Protective"),
    sum(surv$sig & surv$direction == "Protective" & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 1),
    sum(surv$sig & surv$direction == "Protective" & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 0)),
  Risk = c(sum(surv$sig & surv$direction == "Risk"),
    sum(surv$sig & surv$direction == "Risk" & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 1),
    sum(surv$sig & surv$direction == "Risk" & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 0))
)
summary_df$Pct_sig <- round(summary_df$Significant / summary_df$Tested * 100, 1)

knitr::kable(summary_df, caption = "Per-gene survival associations (Cox PH, median split, p<0.05)")
```

# 5. Rank-Ordered Survival Association Plots {.tabset}

Genes are ranked by log2(hazard ratio). HR < 1 (protective) means higher
expression is associated with better survival; HR > 1 (risk) means higher
expression is associated with worse survival.

```{r rank-setup}
sig_colors <- c("Protective (p<0.05)" = "#377EB8",
                "Not significant" = "grey70",
                "Risk (p<0.05)" = "#E41A1C")
n_label <- 8
```

## All Differentiation Genes

```{r rank-all, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
surv_ranked <- surv %>%
  dplyr::arrange(log2_hr) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    sig_dir = factor(case_when(
      sig & direction == "Protective" ~ "Protective (p<0.05)",
      sig & direction == "Risk" ~ "Risk (p<0.05)",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    ), levels = c("Protective (p<0.05)", "Not significant", "Risk (p<0.05)"))
  )

label_df <- rbind(
  surv_ranked %>% dplyr::filter(sig, direction == "Protective") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(log2_hr) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = n_label),
  surv_ranked %>% dplyr::filter(sig, direction == "Risk") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(log2_hr)) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = n_label)
)

ggplot(surv_ranked, aes(x = rank, y = log2_hr, color = sig_dir)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = surv_ranked %>% dplyr::filter(H3K27me3_bin == 1),
    aes(shape = "H3K27me3+"), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_label_repel(data = label_df,
    aes(label = hgnc_symbol), size = 3, fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.4, max.overlaps = 20,
    fill = "white", alpha = 0.9, label.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors, name = "Survival association") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("H3K27me3+" = 17), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = paste0("Rank (", nrow(surv_ranked), " differentiation genes)"),
       y = expression(log[2](Hazard~Ratio)),
       title = "All differentiation genes ranked by survival association",
       subtitle = "SHH medulloblastoma (Cavalli et al.), median-split Cox PH") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# 6. Protective vs Risk Gene Counts

```{r bar-chart, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
bar_data <- surv %>%
  dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene_group, direction) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

totals <- surv %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_total = n(), n_sig = sum(sig), .groups = "drop")

bar_data <- bar_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(totals, by = "gene_group") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = n / n_total * 100)

nonsig_data <- totals %>%
  dplyr::mutate(direction = "Not significant", n = n_total - n_sig,
                pct = n / n_total * 100) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_group, direction, n, n_total, n_sig, pct)

bar_all <- rbind(bar_data, nonsig_data) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(direction = factor(direction,
    levels = c("Protective", "Not significant", "Risk")))

dir_colors <- c("Protective" = "#377EB8", "Not significant" = "grey85", "Risk" = "#E41A1C")

# Fisher's tests
fisher_sig <- matrix(c(
  sum(surv$sig & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 1), sum(surv$sig & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 0),
  sum(!surv$sig & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 1), sum(!surv$sig & surv$H3K27me3_bin == 0)
), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
ft_sig <- fisher.test(fisher_sig)

sig_only <- surv %>% dplyr::filter(sig)
fisher_dir <- matrix(c(
  sum(sig_only$direction == "Protective" & sig_only$H3K27me3_bin == 1),
  sum(sig_only$direction == "Protective" & sig_only$H3K27me3_bin == 0),
  sum(sig_only$direction == "Risk" & sig_only$H3K27me3_bin == 1),
  sum(sig_only$direction == "Risk" & sig_only$H3K27me3_bin == 0)
), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
ft_dir <- fisher.test(fisher_dir)

p_count <- ggplot(bar_data, aes(x = gene_group, y = n, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    vjust = -0.5, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Protective" = "#377EB8", "Risk" = "#E41A1C"), name = "Direction") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of genes (p<0.05)",
       title = "Protective vs risk: differentiation genes in SHH-MB survival",
       subtitle = paste0("K27+ sig enrichment: OR=", round(ft_sig$estimate, 2),
         ", p=", format(ft_sig$p.value, digits = 2),
         " | K27+ protective vs risk: OR=", round(ft_dir$estimate, 2),
         ", p=", format(ft_dir$p.value, digits = 2))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  ylim(0, max(bar_data$n) * 1.15)

p_pct <- ggplot(bar_all, aes(x = gene_group, y = pct, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = bar_all %>% dplyr::filter(direction != "Not significant"),
    aes(label = n), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_colors, name = "Survival\nassociation") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of genes",
       title = "Survival association of differentiation genes (p<0.05)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

plot_grid(p_count, p_pct, nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B"), label_size = 14)
```

# 7. Kaplan-Meier Curves for Top Genes

Top 3 protective and top 3 risk H3K27me3-bound differentiation genes by
p-value, showing the survival curves for high vs low expression groups.

```{r km-plots, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
top3_prot <- surv_k27 %>% dplyr::filter(sig, direction == "Protective") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cox_pval) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 3)
top3_risk <- surv_k27 %>% dplyr::filter(sig, direction == "Risk") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cox_pval) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 3)
km_genes <- rbind(top3_prot, top3_risk)

km_plots <- list()
for (j in 1:nrow(km_genes)) {
  ens_id <- km_genes$hg_ensembl_gene_id.y[j]
  hgnc <- km_genes$hgnc_symbol[j]
  mouse <- km_genes$mgi_symbol[j]
  hr_val <- round(km_genes$cox_hr[j], 2)
  dir_label <- km_genes$direction[j]

  ge <- as.numeric(expr_diff[expr_diff$EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77 == ens_id, shh_ids])
  names(ge) <- shh_ids
  med <- median(ge, na.rm = TRUE)
  km_df <- data.frame(Study_ID = shh_ids,
    expr_group = factor(ifelse(ge > med, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shh_clinical[, c("Study_ID", "os_time", "os_event")], by = "Study_ID")

  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ expr_group, data = km_df)
  km_plots[[j]] <- ggsurvplot(km_fit, data = km_df,
    pval = TRUE, pval.method = TRUE, risk.table = FALSE,
    palette = c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C"),
    title = paste0(hgnc, " (", mouse, ") — ", dir_label, ", HR=", hr_val),
    xlab = "Overall survival (years)", ylab = "Survival probability",
    legend.title = "Expression", legend.labs = c("Low", "High"),
    ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 10),
    font.main = c(10, "bold"))
}

km_grobs <- lapply(km_plots, function(p) p$plot)
gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs = km_grobs, nrow = 2, ncol = 3,
  top = grid::textGrob("Top survival-associated H3K27me3-bound differentiation genes",
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")))
```

# 8. Gene Set Comparison

Survival associations stratified by 4 gene sets defined by H3K27me3 binding
and EZH2 anticorrelation status. This tests whether Polycomb-target genes
that are EZH2-anticorrelated show a distinct survival pattern.

```{r geneset-comparison, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
# Merge gene set info with survival results
surv_sets <- merge(surv, diff_de[, c("hg_ensembl_gene_id.y", "ezh2_anticorr", "gene_set")],
  by = "hg_ensembl_gene_id.y")

set_colors <- c("H3K27me3+ & EZH2-anticorr" = "#E41A1C",
                "H3K27me3+ only" = "#377EB8",
                "EZH2-anticorr only" = "#FF7F00",
                "Other diff gene" = "grey70")

# Proportion significant per gene set
set_summary <- surv_sets %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene_set) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(), n_sig = sum(sig),
    n_prot = sum(sig & direction == "Protective"),
    n_risk = sum(sig & direction == "Risk"),
    pct_sig = round(n_sig / n * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(set_summary,
  caption = "Survival associations by gene set",
  col.names = c("Gene set", "N", "Sig", "Protective", "Risk", "% Sig"))

# Bar plot
set_bar <- surv_sets %>%
  dplyr::filter(sig) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene_set, direction) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(set_bar, aes(x = gene_set, y = n, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Protective" = "#377EB8", "Risk" = "#E41A1C"), name = "Direction") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of genes (p<0.05)",
       title = "Survival-associated genes by H3K27me3/EZH2 classification") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1)) +
  ylim(0, max(set_bar$n) * 1.2)
```

# 9. Combinatorial Analysis: EZH2 × Differentiation Gene Metagene

We stratify patients by both EZH2 expression and differentiation gene metagene
score (mean z-scored expression across gene sets) to test whether the combination
of low EZH2 and high differentiation gene expression predicts survival.

```{r combo-setup}
# Metagene computation: z-score each gene across patients, then average
compute_metagene <- function(ens_ids, expr_df, sample_ids) {
  sub_expr <- expr_df %>% dplyr::filter(EnsemblGeneID_from_ensemblv77 %in% ens_ids)
  mat <- as.matrix(sub_expr[, sample_ids])
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  colMeans(mat_z, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# EZH2 per patient
ezh2_expr <- as.numeric(expr_raw[expr_raw$HGNC_symbol_from_ensemblv77 == "EZH2", shh_ids])
names(ezh2_expr) <- shh_ids

# Metagenes for 3 gene sets
metagene_all <- compute_metagene(diff_de$hg_ensembl_gene_id.y, expr_diff, shh_ids)
metagene_k27 <- compute_metagene(
  diff_de$hg_ensembl_gene_id.y[diff_de$H3K27me3_bin == 1], expr_diff, shh_ids)
metagene_k27ez <- compute_metagene(
  diff_de$hg_ensembl_gene_id.y[diff_de$gene_set == "H3K27me3+ & EZH2-anticorr"],
  expr_diff, shh_ids)

# Build patient data
patient_df <- data.frame(
  Study_ID = shh_ids, EZH2 = ezh2_expr,
  meta_all = metagene_all, meta_k27 = metagene_k27, meta_k27ez = metagene_k27ez,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(shh_clinical[, c("Study_ID", "os_time", "os_event", "Subtype")],
    by = "Study_ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    EZH2_group = ifelse(EZH2 > median(EZH2), "EZH2-High", "EZH2-Low"),
    diff_group = ifelse(meta_k27ez > median(meta_k27ez), "Diff-High", "Diff-Low"),
    combo = factor(paste0(EZH2_group, " / ", diff_group),
      levels = c("EZH2-Low / Diff-High", "EZH2-Low / Diff-Low",
                 "EZH2-High / Diff-Low", "EZH2-High / Diff-High"))
  )
```

## Kaplan-Meier: EZH2 × H3K27me3+/EZH2-Anticorrelated Metagene

```{r combo-km, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
combo_colors <- c("EZH2-Low / Diff-High" = "#4DAF4A",
                   "EZH2-Low / Diff-Low" = "#984EA3",
                   "EZH2-High / Diff-Low" = "#FF7F00",
                   "EZH2-High / Diff-High" = "#E41A1C")

cat("Group sizes:\n"); print(table(patient_df$combo))
cat("\nEvents per group:\n"); print(tapply(patient_df$os_event, patient_df$combo, sum))

fit_combo <- survfit(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ combo, data = patient_df)

ggsurvplot(fit_combo, data = patient_df,
  pval = TRUE, pval.method = TRUE,
  palette = combo_colors,
  risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.height = 0.28, risk.table.fontsize = 3,
  title = "EZH2 × H3K27me3+/EZH2-Anticorrelated Differentiation Gene Metagene",
  xlab = "Overall survival (years)", ylab = "Survival probability",
  legend.title = "Group",
  ggtheme = theme_bw(base_size = 11),
  font.main = c(12, "bold"))
```

## Scatter: EZH2 vs Metagene

```{r combo-scatter, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
patient_df$outcome <- ifelse(patient_df$os_event == 1, "Deceased", "Alive")

ggplot(patient_df, aes(x = EZH2, y = meta_k27ez)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(patient_df$EZH2), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = median(patient_df$meta_k27ez), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(color = combo, shape = outcome), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = combo_colors, name = "Group") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Alive" = 1, "Deceased" = 16), name = "Status") +
  annotate("text", x = min(patient_df$EZH2) + 0.1, y = max(patient_df$meta_k27ez),
    label = "EZH2-Low / Diff-High", hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold", color = "#4DAF4A") +
  annotate("text", x = max(patient_df$EZH2) - 0.1, y = min(patient_df$meta_k27ez),
    label = "EZH2-High / Diff-Low", hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold", color = "#FF7F00") +
  labs(x = "EZH2 expression", y = "H3K27me3+/EZH2-anticorr metagene (z-score)",
       title = "EZH2 vs Polycomb-target differentiation gene expression",
       subtitle = "Dashed lines = median split; filled = deceased") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# 10. Continuous Cox Models

Median splits lose power. Here we test EZH2 and metagene scores as continuous
variables in Cox models, including multivariate models adjusting for SHH subtype.

```{r continuous-cox}
# Univariate models
models <- list(
  "EZH2 (continuous)" = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ EZH2, data = patient_df),
  "All diff metagene" = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ meta_all, data = patient_df),
  "K27+ diff metagene" = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ meta_k27, data = patient_df),
  "K27+/EZH2-anticorr metagene" = coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ meta_k27ez, data = patient_df)
)

univar_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(models), function(nm) {
  cs <- summary(models[[nm]])$coefficients
  data.frame(Model = nm, HR = round(exp(cs[1, "coef"]), 3),
    p = format(cs[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], digits = 4), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

knitr::kable(univar_results, caption = "Univariate Cox models (continuous predictors)")
```

```{r multivariate-cox}
# Bivariate: EZH2 + K27/EZH2-anticorr metagene
cx_biv <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ EZH2 + meta_k27ez, data = patient_df)
cat("Bivariate: EZH2 + K27+/EZH2-anticorr metagene\n")
print(round(summary(cx_biv)$coefficients, 4))

# Full model with subtype
cx_full <- coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ EZH2 + meta_k27ez + Subtype, data = patient_df)
cat("\nFull model: EZH2 + K27+/EZH2-anticorr metagene + SHH subtype\n")
print(round(summary(cx_full)$coefficients, 4))
```

**Key finding:** In the full multivariate model adjusting for SHH subtype,
both EZH2 expression and the H3K27me3+/EZH2-anticorrelated differentiation
gene metagene remain independently significant predictors of overall survival.

# 11. Top Treatment Candidates

H3K27me3-bound differentiation genes where high expression is associated with
better survival (protective). These are Polycomb-repressed in progenitors and
their de-repression may promote a more differentiated, less aggressive state.

```{r treatment-candidates}
candidates <- surv_k27 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sig, direction == "Protective") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cox_pval) %>%
  dplyr::select(hgnc_symbol, mgi_symbol, cox_hr, cox_pval, H3K27me3)

knitr::kable(candidates, digits = c(NA, NA, 3, 5, 2),
  col.names = c("Human symbol", "Mouse symbol", "HR", "p-value", "H3K27me3 level"),
  caption = "H3K27me3-bound protective differentiation genes (higher expression = better survival)")
```

```{r risk-genes}
risk_genes <- surv_k27 %>%
  dplyr::filter(sig, direction == "Risk") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cox_pval) %>%
  dplyr::select(hgnc_symbol, mgi_symbol, cox_hr, cox_pval, H3K27me3)

knitr::kable(risk_genes, digits = c(NA, NA, 3, 5, 2),
  col.names = c("Human symbol", "Mouse symbol", "HR", "p-value", "H3K27me3 level"),
  caption = "H3K27me3-bound risk differentiation genes (higher expression = worse survival)")
```
